newsitem.title: USA: Kollmorgen sells 48 pct interest in Gretag.
newsitem.headline: Kollmorgen sells 48 pct interest in Gretag.

text.p: Kollmorgen Corp said on Tuesday that it sold 48 percent interest in Gretag-Macbeth Holding AG as part of a public offering of Gretag-Macbeth shares on the Swiss stock exchange.
The pretax proceeds to Kollmorgen from the offering are expected to be in excess of $40 million.
Gretag-Macbeth Holding AG was formed in January 1997 as a joint venture comprising Kollmorgen's Macbeth business and the Color Control Systems division of Gretag AG.
Gretag-Macbeth will be listed on the Swiss stock exchange on June 25.
Kollmorgen agreed to sell its shares to the Swiss underwriter, Bank J. Vontobel and Co AG.
Kollmorgen expects to receive the majority of the funds from the sale of its interest before the end of the second quarter on June 30.
